change: Corrected primary/secondary split for hip abduction. EMG research confirms Gluteus Medius is the prime mover of hip abduction; moved Gluteus Maximus from primary to secondary (it assists but is not the main driver in pure abduction). Tensor Fasciae Latae (Abductor) retained as secondary — it co-activates in hip abduction but is not primary. Result: primary = glutes [Gluteus Medius]; secondary = glutes [Gluteus Maximus] + Abductor [Abductor].

Removed incorrect secondary entry Abductor [Abductor]. This exercise is a hip flexion movement (drawing knees to chest against band resistance), not a hip abduction movement — Abductor/TFL is not meaningfully engaged. Retained Quads [Rectus Femoris] as secondary since Rectus Femoris crosses the hip and assists hip flexion during the knee-draw phase. Primary abs entry unchanged.

Added Lower Traps to the mid back primary entry. Research and biomechanics sources confirm that the lower trapezius is a key scapular depressor/retractor recruited during face pulls (alongside rhomboids and upper traps). The previous entry omitted Lower Traps from the mid back group. All other entries unchanged.
